title: Data model — etcd v3.7
version: etcd v3.7 official online documentation; accessed 2026-11-26.
locator: MVCC logical view and compaction: compaction removes revisions before the compact revision and superseded values, not application-level current values encoded inside a live key.
notes: Used to distinguish backend MVCC revision compaction from application-level Operation Ledger archival. No claim that etcd compaction prunes current aggregate values.
